title: Short title of one concrete change to the constellation design or photo plan
hypothesis: What the baseline loses (too many satellites, or targets missing their revisit requirement), why the change should recover it, and which per-mission quantity (n_satellites, n_targets_missing, worst_gap_h) should move.
implementation_plan: Check on 2 missions with sim.official_check before the official evaluation

target_rubrics.description: program.py defines solve(world, time_limit_s), uses only world/sim/numpy/scipy/brahe/stdlib, returns within 200 s per mission, and leaves evaluate.py, capture.py, sim.py and revisit_verifier.py unchanged
combined_score is above the program_0 score

notes_for_agent: Read per_case n_satellites, n_targets_missing and worst_gap_h in metrics.json, not only combined_score.
